items.title: A Home I Imagine
items.content_text: A home can begin as an idea and take shape in many forms. In this workshop, imagination leads the design process. Through drawing, building, and assembling materials, children develop their own vision of a home and translate it into a tangible model. Each creation results in a constructed home that reflects personal ideas and vision.

items.title: Built by Nature
items.content_text: A bird’s nest, a termite mound, a shell, each one is carefully built, not by chance, but by need. In this workshop, children observe how living things design their homes, then borrow these ideas to sketch and shape their own. Openings for air, layers for protection, and smart use of materials begin to appear in their designs. What starts in nature slowly turns into a built form.

items.title: My Family Bouquet
items.content_text: A bouquet grows, one flower at a time. In this hands-on workshop, children begin with simple shapes and watch them take form as each piece is rolled, combined, and built into a flower. Colors are chosen, details are added, and the process repeats, each new bloom adding to the whole. As the bouquet comes together, each flower stands for someone at home, gathered into one arrangement shaped through making and choice.

items.title: Treasures in Every Home
items.content_text: Deep within the Earth, metal begins its journey, formed over time and transformed into materials we use every day at home. In this interactive workshop, children follow this journey, then reshape a simple tin container into a new functional object. The activity introduces how materials can be reused and redesigned for new purposes..

items.title: My Neighbor Totoro
items.content_text: A gentle and magical tale by Studio Ghibli that celebrates the innocence of childhood, the quiet beauty of nature, and the meaning of home found in family. Through the eyes of two sisters who move to the countryside, the story unfolds into a world of forest spirits and unseen friends.

items.title: Kindergarten Under the Palm Tree (English)
items.content_text: Produced by the King Abdulaziz Center for World Culture (Ithra), a new animated series makes its debut! Set in the diverse environments of Saudi Arabia, small animals embark on charming adventures, discovering the meaning of early emotions such as gratitude and joy in a warm world designed for young children.

items.title: انطلاق النادي الصيفي التاسع لجامعة القصيم
items.content_text: فعالية عامة مدرجة في تقويم جامعة القصيم. الموعد المعلن: 12 يوليو 2026، 4:30 مساءً. انطلاق النادي الصيفي التاسع لجامعة القصيم ضمن جامعات ومجتمع في بريدة. تبدأ الفعالية ١٢‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٤:٣٠ م وتنتهي ١٢‏/٠٧‏/٢٠٢٦، ٦:٣٠ م حسب البيانات المتاحة. تعرض الصفحة وقت الفعالية وموقعها ومصدرها وروابط التقويم والاتجاهات عند توفرها. المصدر: Qassim University Events.

items.title: Night at Ithra
items.content_text: An exclusive family experience for Ithra members. Imagine Ithra transformed into a living, breathing home, where footsteps soften and a new experience begins. “A Night at Ithra” is an immersive evening for families to explore a range of curated spaces across Ithra. The program moves through key locations including the Children’s Museum, library, theater, museum, and outdoor areas, with each stop offering a different activity or perspective. The evening concludes with a shared meal and an optional film screening. Designed for families with children aged 7 and above.

items.title: Nature's Architects
items.content_text: Nature builds without blueprints, yet every structure serves a clear purpose. The experience begins with a short film that reveals how living organisms design and construct their homes. This is followed by hands-on activities where children explore these ideas further, testing, building, and observing how form responds to need. The workshop connects observation with practical understanding.

items.title: Finding Nemo
items.content_text: Everything changes when a father clownfish loses his son in a single moment, setting off on a journey across vast distances and endless dangers. Amid the ocean’s shifting waves, the search becomes a test that reveals the strength of family bonds that never break, no matter how far apart they are.

items.title: Kinusaiga Art
items.content_text: This workshop invites mothers and children to explore the meaning of home through texture, layering and memory. Using the contemporary fabric Japanese art of Kinusaiga, participants will create a fabric piece by choosing materials that feel familiar and comforting. The experience celebrates how home is felt through touch, emotion and personal expression.

items.title: The Lorax
items.content_text: In a world where trees have disappeared, a young boy named Ted goes on a journey to discover a real tree. Along the way, he encounters the Lorax, a guardian who speaks on behalf of the trees. This leads to a journey that reveals the importance of protecting nature and caring for the environment.

items.title: Introduction to Jewelry Making Techniques
items.content_text: Course Description: This foundational jewelry course welcomes jewelry designers, artisan craftsmen, metalsmiths and jewelers to learn all about fundamental jewelry making techniques. By the end of the course, participants will be able to practice several jewelry techniques and translate their designs into wearable unique pieces of jewelry. Course Objectives: 1- Introduce participants to jewelry techniques such as sawing, drilling, piercing, hammer texturing, filing, sanding and polishing 2- Utilize design templates 3- Draw to scale 4- Transfer designs to metal sheets 5- Create a set of jewelry (not just one piece, but two pieces that go together) Course Outcomes: 1- To utilize the skills lea

items.title: From a Paper to a Book in the Libraries of the World
items.content_text: An interactive workshop where children unleash their creativity by combining drawing with their imagination, transforming a blank sheet into a story painting.

items.title: A House Reads: A Story that Begins with the Family
items.content_text: An interactive workshop designed for children to discover the reading boosters that ignite their passion for books, and create a lifelong friendship with reading, making books their closest companions.

items.title: معسكر تطوير البرمجيات السحابية الاحترافية لسحابة قوقل
items.content_text: معسكر تدريبي مصمم لتزويد المطورين بالمهارات والمعرفة اللازمة لتصميم، وبناء، ونشر، وإدارة برمجيات عالية الأداء، قابلة للتطوير، وموثوقة على Google Cloud Platform, موجهة للمطورين الذين يمتلكون خبرة أساسية في البرمجة ويرغبون في الانتقال إلى ... المصدر الرسمي: أكاديمية طويق.

items.title: Tinkering Stations
items.content_text: Interactive spaces where your children can explore, create, experiment and have hands-on learning experiences. Join the challenge and participate in many practical experiments, which allow you to assemble, test and transform your ideas and creativity into a tangible product. Use different materials to create whatever you want, whether it is a car, a house, a rocket or anything else. Join us to start designing and bring your ideas to life!

items.title: Workshop at the Library
items.content_text: Join us at the Ithra Library as we read a different story each time, enriching our imagination through it, followed by a workshop inspired by the tale to reinforce its values and deepen its meaning. You will also have the opportunity to use various materials and tools, repurposing them to create new shapes! Innovate and create with your friends and family, spending time full of knowledge, crafting unique pieces, and exploring fresh techniques.

items.title: All Things Hedgehogs
items.content_text: Do you have what it takes to uncover the secrets of hedgehogs and discover amazing facts about them? In this workshop, we will dive into the wonderful world of hedgehogs and create our own hedgehog using everything we have learned about these fascinating creatures.

items.title: Children's Museum - Free Monday
items.content_text: It's finally the first Monday of every month, where the Children's Museum opens its doors during different times throughout the day. Offering a special free ticket for you and your family to join us for two hours and a half and take part in fun and interactive workshops.

items.title: Paint Like an Artist
items.content_text: Are you ready to dive into the world of art and culture? This exciting and hands-on workshop is perfect for young artists eager to explore the incredible techniques of famous Saudi and Arabic painters.

items.title: The Almost Perfect Guide to Event Management
items.content_text: This introductory course welcomes anyone curious about event management, regardless of prior experience. Over four interactive days , participants will discover the core principles of organizing an event, from concept and audience definition to budgeting, logistics, marketing and on-day operations. Working in small groups, participants will choose their event type (cultural, sport, corporate or wedding) and develop a complete event plan from scratch, which they present before a jury. Inspired by real-world case studies and a guest professional from the industry, the course is as much a personal journey as a practical one, challenging participants to think creatively, collaborate under pressu

items.title: Tangram
items.content_text: This workshop invites children to explore the game of Tangram through a fun and interactive hands-on activity. Participants will create their own Tangram pieces and then experiment with arranging them to form various designs and shapes, enhancing their problem-solving skills and creative thinking.

items.title: معسكر الأنظمة الذاتية للدرونز
items.content_text: معسكر تدريبي متقدم يركز على الجوانب البرمجية والعملية لتطوير الدرونز المسيرة، من خلال فهم معمارية أنظمة الطيار الآلي والتعامل مع المحاكيات لاختبار أداء الدرونز في بيئات افتراضية. المصدر الرسمي: أكاديمية طويق.

items.title: Platforms Manager Skills
items.content_text: Platform Manager Skills is a course that focuses on developing the skills of moderators and speakers specializing in cultural events. From preparations to body language, this course explores your potential in public speaking and presentation skills. The course also includes real-life scenarios for the participants to train with and present in front of the other participants. Course objectives: Applying real-life scenarios and how participants can deal with them. Present different real-life examples of good and bad platform management. Explore tools and techniques to help participants research better and prepare more professionally for any session Allow participants to share their experiences

items.title: Creative Character Design
items.content_text: This course aims to provide the necessary knowledge to craft simplistic and flat characters that can be used for personal projects and client work. This course welcomes artists, illustrators, and graphic designers to create stylized character designs using Adobe Illustrator with a focus on keeping things simple, expressive, and intentional. This course will increase the skills of those who already obtain basic knowledge regarding Adobe Illustrator. Participants will learn how Al Refai’s methods regarding approaching character creation by exploring different ways to draw faces, bodies, proportions, and poses. Moreover, participants will play with various styles while covering the basics

items.title: معسكر طويق السيبراني
items.content_text: يهدف هذا المعسكر إلى تأهيل المشاركين لاكتساب مهارات متقدمة في الأمن السيبراني عبر تدريب عملي مكثف يشمل حماية الأنظمة والشبكات ومواقع الويب، تحليل الثغرات الأمنية، واستخدام أدوات متقدمة لتقييم المخاطر. المصدر الرسمي: أكاديمية طويق.

items.title: معسكر هندسة الحوسبة السحابية باستخدام Google Cloud
items.content_text: يهدف المعسكر إلى تأهيل المتدربين بالمهارات العملية لتصميم وتنفيذ الحلول السحابية على Google Cloud بكفاءة. المصدر الرسمي: أكاديمية طويق.

items.title: Podcast Production: From the Field to Storytelling
items.content_text: Producers have a strong intuition that allows them to uncover hidden stories and present them in a cohesive, professional, and engaging way. This means producers are always "on" in their daily lives—at family gatherings, waiting at traffic lights, chatting with the car service driver, or navigating heated debates at social events. Production isn’t just a job; it’s a lifestyle and a mindset. In this comprehensive course, participants will gain the essential skills and foundational knowledge needed to create a complete, professional podcast episode. The curriculum covers every stage of the process: identifying and refining ideas into compelling episode topics, conducting fiel

items.title: The Innovation Diwan
items.content_text: A national initiative aimed at enhancing creativity and innovation among young Saudi youth by providing youth with the opportunity to present solutions to community challenges. المصدر الرسمي: Misk Hub.

items.content_text: يهدف معسكر الحوكمة والمخاطر GRC إلى تأهيل المشاركين من خلال التركيز على فهم مبادئ الحوكمة واستراتيجيات تنفيذها، وتحليل وتقييم المخاطر مع تطوير خطط للتعامل معها، ويشمل المعسكر التعرف على اللوائح والقوانين وتنفيذ استراتيجيات امتثال فعالة، ... المصدر الرسمي: أكاديمية طويق.

items.title: Islamic Wood Mastery: Inlay Hexagonal Jewelry Box & Joinery for Mangour Screens
items.content_text: This six-day course welcomes artists, designers, architects, and those with a passion for heritage crafts and woodwork to merge the intricate art of wood inlay with precious materials and the enduring tradition of Islamic wood joinery. Participants will explore techniques from the Mamluk and Hijazi traditions while collaboratively creating a large Mangour screen and a wooden jewelry box inlaid with materials such as mother-of-pearl, camel bone, ebony, and brass. The course blends theory, history, and hands-on practice, allowing participants to learn about the cultural and architectural significance of Mangour screens and gain hands-on carving and inlaying skills. Moreover, the participants w

items.title: Kingdom Business Luxury Travel Congress
items.content_text: The 5th Annual Kingdom Business Luxury Travel Congress 2026 (KBLT) takes place in Riyadh on 15–16 September 2026, offering a boutique, content-led platform designed for high-level discussions and real business outcomes. Under the theme “The Saudi Connection – Outbound Travel Meets Global Opportunities,” the event connects global luxury travel and hospitality suppliers with Saudi Arabia’s budget-holding buyers through an invitation-only, pre-qualified audience and structured one-to-one meetings. With a tailored agenda focused matchmaking and networking, KBLT provides targeted access to the Kingdom’s fast-growing outbound luxury travel segment while spotlighting Saudi change-makers shaping the future of travel, hospitality, and premium experiences in line with Vision 2030. Register Now

items.title: The Playful Art Of Critical Thinking
items.content_text: Course Brief Description: This dynamic and interactive course combines playful activities, creativity, and open discussions to explore critical thinking. Participants will learn how to assess information critically, think creatively, and make informed decisions using logic in an engaging, enjoyable, and inspiring environment. Course Objectives: Understanding the importance of critical thinking Developing skills to critically question information and arguments. Fostering open-mindedness and intellectual humility. Learning strategies and tools for effective critical thinking. Appreciating diverse perspectives in decision-making. Course Outcomes: Articulating the concept and significance of cri

items.title: Advanced Wheel Throwing
items.content_text: This is an applied and professional cultural course in the art of pottery for the intermediate level. This engaging course, which spans five days, targets amateur beginner ceramicists or those with intermediate experience who love handicrafts. It is presented within an enthusiastic educational framework, aiming to deepen the understanding of handicrafts as a proud, inherited artistic and cultural practice. Additionally, this course focuses on developing clay modeling skills by expanding the knowledge of materials and tools, while enhancing the mastery of hand-building techniques. The course includes progressive practical applications that enable participants to refine their craft skills and

items.title: The Soul of Place: Leveraging Folklore and Local Heritage in Narrative Writing
items.content_text: This interactive course offers a comprehensive introduction and explanation for participating short story writers and novelists on the methods of drawing inspiration from folklore and folk heritage. It covers the construction of spatial settings, their utilization within the novel and how to artistically leverage the potential of folk heritage as a means to add authenticity to writing, enhance identity and make the writer portray their environment and culture. This interactive course will enable the supervisor to assist participants in completing their novel projects throughout the duration of the course and producing an integrated and successful narrative project. Course Objectives: Recogni

items.title: Immersive Introduction to Arabic Writing and Type Design
items.content_text: This 4-day course introduces students and professionals in graphic design or typography who wish to engage meaningfully with Arabic script, whether or not they have prior type design experience, to the foundations of Arabic type design through an integrated approach combining historical background, critical analysis, drawing exercises and digital implementation. Participants will leave with a small but functional set of digitized Arabic letters and a collective printed specimen of their work. Course Objectives: Gaining a historical and stylistic overview of Arabic scripts Learning fundamental principles of Arabic type structure, modulation and contrast Understanding the interplay between con

items.title: Making Short Films
items.content_text: Filmmakers, photographers, cinematographers and actors are welcomed to join us for a seven-day filmmaking course under the supervision of Jaan Al-Balushi. Nearly 20 participants will come to Ithra every day from 4 to 9 p.m. to cover the stages of filmmaking, starting from the idea and scriptwriting, filming, and, finally, to editing. Editing equipment, such as the Adobe Premiere software, will be available. At the end of the course, three individual teams will each produce a short film ranging between two to seven minutes. Course Objectives: Gaining a comprehensive understanding of short films, including their history, genres and techniques Developing critical thinking and analytical skills

items.title: Arabic Calligraphy × Woodworks: From Script to Object
items.content_text: This workshop explores the transformation of Arabic calligraphy from a written system into a constructed wooden object. Participants engage with letterforms as structural elements rather than decorative motifs, translating them into physical compositions through a process that combines sketching, digital vectorization and fabrication. Course Objectives: Understand the structural logic of Arabic calligraphy beyond visual aesthetics Explore the relationship between language and material Develop the ability to translate two dimensional script into physical objects Learn the fundamentals of vector design for fabrication Gain awareness of wood properties and fabrication constraints Course Outcome

items.title: Content Creation for Conversational Podcasts
items.content_text: This specialized training course focuses on the fundamentals of talk podcasting, explaining why it is a rapidly growing platform with seven million listeners in Saudi Arabia and 180% annual growth and how it achieves an 80% audience retention rate. The course covers podcast types, how to build a general theme, identify target audiences using the Customer Persona model and highlights the research skills needed to create valuable content and select successful guests. It also details content creation skills, such as transforming gathered information into broadcast ready materials: including questions, media and descriptions, while mastering guest introductions, attractive titles and professiona

items.title: The Art Of Writing A Novel
items.content_text: This is an intensive training course based on the Professional Writer model. Moreover, we seek to create a new and unique model in teaching novel writing. This course is designed for novelists, both beginners and those with experience, who are interested in learning the basics and methods of novel writing, developing their skills and who aspire to publish their first works. Throughout this intensive course, participants will present their own narrative experiences through written novel proposals.
